psql_bin.description: Path to the PostgreSQL client binary used by SiSU to interact with the database.

pg_database.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database where SiSU stores its indexed content.

pg_user.description: PostgreSQL username with permissions to read/write the SiSU database.

pg_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the PostgreSQL server.

pg_port.description: TCP port number for the PostgreSQL server connection.

sisu_doc_paths.description: List of absolute paths to directories containing SiSU source documents to be indexed.

enable_granular_index.description: Flag to enable paragraph-level indexing for granular search results.

enable_object_citations.description: Flag to enable tracking of object citation numbers for document indexing.
